subject: [PATCH v4 13/14] selftests/nfsd: check that listener_set asks rpcbind once

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch adds tests to the selftests/nfsd module to ensure that the listener_set request only asks rpcbind once. The patch introduces new constants and procedures, including RPCB_STUB_SILENT, which silences a call without sending an answer, and version_set_only(), which makes the server v4-only by clearing all versions before reading the request. The tests cover various scenarios, including stopping a listener_set request from registering after rpcbind stops answering, checking that unregistration is handled correctly, and verifying that multiple listeners are not registered unnecessarily.
